SUMMARY: /8" Intermediate Casing & Differential Sticking Incident Report in
Tipam Sandstone at 2,780 m. VERBATIM OPERATIONAL LOG: OPERATIONAL SUMMARY:
Differential sticking encountered at 2,780 m across high-permeability (520 mD)
Tipam sandstone due to 340 psi hydrostatic overbalance. Freed pipe using 15 bbl
organic surfactant spotting fluid. Subsequent /8" casing cementing utilized
fiber-laced 1.42 sg lead slurry to prevent breakdown across weak Tipam-Barail
transition.
